Job Description

As a member of the Commercial Operations department and of the Data team you will have the opportunity to contribute to the transformation, harmonization and continuous improvement of the way analysis and insights are created, by leveraging on innovative data platforms, in order to deliver actionable insights to the business.

Your profile

  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to work 30-40 hours per week
  • Graduating in Q3 2027 or later
  • Education in Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Technology is preferable
  • Skills in data analysis
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Preferred experience in visualization tools like PowerBI.

What we offer?

  • Monthly stipend
  • Hybrid work format
  • Buddy and mentor support during your journey
  • Learning opportunities.

Additional location(s) Compensation Information

Required Skills

Analytical Thinking, Analytics Insights, Computer Science, Data Analysis, Data Analysis Tools, Data Modeling, Data Operations, Data Science, Data Visualization
